title: Take the cure, not the diagnosis
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Keep this close: Hold onto this: treat ego as illness and keep the Guru's medicine near.
takeaway: Interrogate the voice before you obey it.
lifeApplication: When ego flares in a conversation, apology, or success, pause before the sentence lands and take one lowering action: listen, yield, or ask forgiveness.

source.shortMeaning: Ego stops being theory when the Guru's cure is actually taken.
source.lifeApplication: When ego flares, take one lowering action before you let it speak.
